mapper.select: SELECT id, damage_no, store_id, damage_type, reason, total_qty, total_amount, status, audit_by, audit_at, execute_by, execute_at, review_by, create_time FROM ph_inv_damage WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND deleted = b'0'

SELECT l.id, l.damage_id, l.batch_id, l.location_id, l.drug_id, l.batch_no, l.qty, l.cost_price, l.amount, l.dispose_type FROM ph_inv_damage_line l JOIN ph_inv_damage d ON d.id = l.damage_id AND d.tenant_id = l.tenant_id WHERE l.damage_id = #{id} AND l.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND d.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND l.deleted = b'0' AND d.deleted = b'0' ORDER BY l.id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ph_inv_damage (tenant_id, damage_no, store_id, damage_type, reason, status, total_qty, total_amount, destroy_method, destroy_company, creator, updater) VALUES (#{scope.tenantId}, #{damageNo}, #{scope.storeId}, #{q.damageType}, #{q.reason}, 0, 0, 0, #{q.destroyMethod}, #{q.destroyCompany}, #{operator}, #{operator})

INSERT INTO ph_inv_damage_line (tenant_id, damage_id, batch_id, drug_id, batch_no, qty, cost_price, amount, dispose_type, location_id, creator, updater) VALUES (#{scope.tenantId}, #{damageId}, #{line.batchId}, #{batch.drugId}, #{batch.batchNo}, #{line.qty}, #{batch.costPrice}, #{amount}, #{line.disposeType}, #{line.locationId}, #{operator}, #{operator})
mapper.update: UPDATE ph_inv_damage d SET total_qty = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.qty), 0) FROM ph_inv_damage_line l WHERE l.damage_id = d.id AND l.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND l.deleted = b'0'), total_amount = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) FROM ph_inv_damage_line l WHERE l.damage_id = d.id AND l.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND l.deleted = b'0'), updater = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND d.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND d.deleted = b'0'
mapper.select: SELECT id, store_id, warehouse_id, drug_id, batch_no, qty_total, qty_avail, qty_frozen, cost_price FROM ph_inv_batch WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.id, s.batch_id, s.location_id, s.qty, s.qty_frozen FROM ph_inv_location_stock s JOIN ph_inv_batch b ON b.id = s.batch_id AND b.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND b.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND b.deleted = b'0' JOIN ph_location l ON l.id = s.location_id AND l.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND l.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id AND l.deleted = b'0' WHERE s.batch_id = #{batchId} AND s.location_id = #{locationId} AND s.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND s.deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT l.id, l.damage_id, l.batch_id, l.location_id, l.drug_id, l.batch_no, d.damage_no, l.qty, l.cost_price FROM ph_inv_damage_line l JOIN ph_inv_damage d ON d.id = l.damage_id AND d.tenant_id = l.tenant_id WHERE l.damage_id = #{id} AND l.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND d.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND l.deleted = b'0' AND d.deleted = b'0' ORDER BY l.batch_id, l.location_id, l.id

UPDATE ph_inv_location_stock SET qty = qty - #{qty}, updater = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0'

UPDATE ph_inv_batch SET qty_total = qty_total - #{qty}, qty_avail = qty_avail - #{qty}, version = version + 1, updater = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND deleted = b'0'
